anomalies.observed: Net VREF+_FCC connects to FCC1 pin 13 (PH1), while FCC1 pin 20 (VREF+) is on an unconnected net.
anomalies.expected: VREF+_FCC should connect to FCC1 pin 20 (VREF+), not to the GPIO pin PH1.
anomalies.impact: The ADC reference pin is left floating and the reference filter is tied to a GPIO, so ADC measurements will be invalid and PH1 is unnecessarily driven by the reference voltage.

anomalies.observed: Net USB_VBUS_FCC connects to FCC1 pin 69 (PA10), which is the USB OTG ID pin, not the VBUS pin.
anomalies.expected: USB_VBUS_FCC should connect to FCC1 pin 68 (PA9 / USB_OTG_FS_VBUS).
anomalies.impact: USB VBUS sensing is connected to the ID pin, so the FCC may not detect USB cable insertion or may misconfigure its USB role.

anomalies.observed: Both FCC1 and NAVC1 BOOT0 pins are on unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: BOOT0 should connect to the boot-select switches specified for FCC and NAVC.
anomalies.impact: The boot-select switches cannot control the BOOT0 pins, so the MCUs cannot be forced into the bootloader via the intended hardware switch.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a clear miswiring of the FCC VREF+ net to PH1 while the actual VREF+ pin is left unconnected, plus a USB VBUS pin swap and unconnected BOOT0 pins. These deviations would impair ADC accuracy, USB enumeration, and boot-mode selection.
